decisions.reason: Having its own webpage and multiple models signals substantial sunk costs and public commitment, making management likely to persist with this product line.
Its closeness to the established offer and existing website presence create ongoing sunk costs that justify continuing the service.
The product line's several models imply significant prior investment, and dropping it would mean abandoning those resources, so the firm keeps it.
The public launch announcement constitutes a visible commitment, and the service's proximity to the established offer makes discontinuation unlikely.
As a newly launched service with its own webpage, the firm has publicly committed to it, and escalation pressures favor giving it more time before considering withdrawal.
